focus_areas: Seed-Crust Interface: Ensure seeds are distinct entities sitting on top of the crust, not melting into it.
Hole Geometry: Verify the central holes are clean and do not have stray dough strands bridging the gap.
Background Consistency: Check the bottle label text for gibberish and the glass geometry for warping.
Spatial Grounding: Ensure the bagels cast appropriate shadows on the napkin and do not appear to float or merge with the fabric.
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the interaction between the poppy/sesame seeds and the bagel surface. In AI images, these often look like painted-on noise rather than physical objects with depth. Also, inspect the bottle in the background; distorted labels or warped glass geometry are common failure modes in food photography generations. Specifically check if the text on the red label is readable or nonsensical.
image_description: Two golden-brown bagels topped with poppy and sesame seeds resting on a crumpled white paper napkin. A dark glass bottle with a red label is visible in the background, slightly out of focus.
